quests.name: The first harvest
quests.text: Harvest 20 Moonwheat on the Meadow Rise terraces. Fly low and keep it smooth.

quests.name: A sickle of your own
quests.text: Make a Wooden sickle at Tobin's workbench and show it to Bramble.

quests.name: Tea for the Lamplighter
quests.text: Brew a Meadow tea at Master Pei's kettle and bring it to Wick before the lanterns are lit.

quests.name: The glacier road
quests.text: Find your way to Frostspine and the Ice Galleries.

quests.name: Starlight supper
quests.text: Catch three Star minnows in the cloud sea for Old Reed.
